papers.title: Ionic‐Ligand‐Assisted Transport in Fluorinated Poly(ionic liquid) Electrolytes Enables 515 Wh Kg −1 Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Decoupling ionic conductivity from polymer segmental relaxation while maintaining interfacial stability remains a pivotal challenge for solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs). In this study, we construct an ionic‐ligand‐assisted transport framework by copolymerizing a fluorinated acrylate polymer with a poly(ionic liquid) (PIL) and optimizing the lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI) salt concentration. Density functional theory and molecular dynamics simulations reveal that cationic PIL moieties strongly anchor FSI − anions, creating anion‐rich, spatially correlated coordination pathways that facilitate efficient Li + hopping. The optimized electrolyte exhibits a high ionic conductivity (0.38 mS cm −1 ) and an exceptional Li + transference number (0.77) at 30°C. The fluorinated backbone and PIL synergistically expand the oxidative stability window to 4.94 V and promote an inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) on the Li‐metal anode. Consequently, Li||Cu cells cycle stably for over 400 cycles with 99.1% average Coulombic efficiency. Solid‐state Li||LiNi 0.9 Co 0.05 Mn 0.05 O 2 (NCM90) cells retain ≈81.0% capacity after 600 cycles at 4.3 V, and ≈83.1% capacity after 200 cycles at 4.5 V. Moreover, a high‐energy‐density (515 Wh kg −1 ) solid‐state pouch cell with an ultrathin Li anode (50 µm) and a high‐loading NCM90 cathode (≈56 mg cm −2 ) delivers stable cycling and exceptional safety. This ionic‐ligand regulation paradigm provides critical mechanistic insights for designing high‐performance and high‐safety solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 불소화 아크릴레이트 고분자와 이온성 액체 고분자(PIL)를 공중합하고 LiFSI 농도를 최적화하여, 양이온성 PIL이 FSI 음이온을 포획해 Li+ 이동 경로를 형성하는 고체 고분자 전해질을 제안했다. 이 전해질은 30°C에서 0.38 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 0.77의 Li+ 이전율을 보이며, 산화 안정성 창을 4.94V까지 확장하고 Li 금속 표면에 무기물 중심의 SEI를 형성한다. Li||Cu 셀은 400회 이상 99.1% 평균 쿨롱효율로 안정 구동하며, 얇은 Li 음극과 고로딩 NCM90 양극을 적용한 515 Wh/kg급 고체상 파우치셀도 안정적으로 작동했다.

papers.title: Beyond Isolated Active Sites: Adjacent Single‐Atom‐Nanoparticle Electronic Coupling Enables Lateral Lithium Growth
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Precise host regulation remains pivotal for dendrite‐free lithium metal anodes (LMAs). While maximizing isolated single‐atom sites improves initial Li nucleation, their uniform adsorption energetics inherently confine Li to these initial sites, favoring localized vertical accumulation over lateral growth. Here we propose an adjacent single‐atom‐nanoparticle electronic coupling strategy to break this thermodynamic bottleneck. Via coordination‐mediated laser direct writing, we construct a hierarchical porous graphene host comprising ultrafine Co nanoparticles and adjacent Co single atoms. Precursor preorganization and the ultrafast, non‐equilibrium kinetics of laser processing concurrently drive in situ graphitization and Co‐species reconstruction, effectively suppressing the aggregation in conventional thermal synthesis. Mechanistically, rather than relying on isolated thermodynamic traps, interfacial electronic coupling reconstructs the local d ‐band center and establishes a directed spatial Li adsorption‐energy gradient. This thermodynamic driving force compels Li to sequentially occupy neighboring sites, effectively precluding localized vertical accumulation. Owing to this spatially regulated deposition, the high‐loading Li||LiFePO 4 full cells retain 71.4% capacity after 1000 cycles at 2 C. This adjacent electronic coupling strategy transcends the isolated active sites paradigm, opening a new dimension for interfacial electronic‐structure regulation in practical LMAs.
papers.summary_ko: 단일 원자 활성점만으로는 Li가 특정 자리에 수직으로 쌓여 덴드라이트가 형성되는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 인접한 Co 단일원자와 Co 나노입자 간 전자 결합을 이용한 호스트 구조를 제안했다. 레이저 직접 기록 공정으로 계층적 다공성 그래핀에 초미세 Co 나노입자와 인접 Co 단일원자를 동시에 형성시켰으며, 이 전자 결합이 국소 d-band 중심을 재구성해 Li 흡착 에너지의 공간적 구배를 만들어 Li가 인접 자리로 순차 성장하도록 유도한다. 이를 적용한 고로딩 Li 음극 기반 완전셀은 2C, 1000회 사이클 후에도 71.4%의 용량을 유지했다.
